what_this_is: Read-only probe of production for objects that named migrations create. It settles applied-vs-unapplied for the migrations added since 2026-08-05; it is NOT a migration ledger and says nothing about the 380+ older files.
method: docker exec -e PGOPTIONS='-c default_transaction_read_only=on' … psql -X -A -t, to_regclass()/pg_proc/pg_policy lookups only

migrations.note: Corrects an earlier working assumption that this migration was local-only.
